name: Asunción
tagline: One of South America's oldest cities on the Paraguay River
summary: Asunción is Paraguay's laid-back capital and one of the continent's oldest cities. See the riverside Palacio de los López and the Pantheon of Heroes, wander colonial Loma San Jerónimo, sip tereré in the plazas, and take a day trip to the Jesuit ruins and the lace-making town of Itauguá.
seasonNote: May to September is mild; summer is very hot.
arrival: Silvio Pettirossi International is 30 minutes from the centre.
gettingAround: Uber and Bolt; buses are cheap but slow.
cashTip: Paraguay uses the guaraní (about 7,500 to 1 US dollar); prices here are in US dollars. Cards work in malls and restaurants; carry guaraníes for buses and markets.
foodTip: Chipa, sopa paraguaya, mbejú and tereré.

connections.note: Bus to Ciudad del Este, then across.
